reason: The frozen five-seed primary cohort has dense within-seed sampling but cannot attain a two-sided exact seed-level p-value below 0.0625. Four additional independently trained checkpoints raise the combined confirmatory cohort to nine seeds without changing or relabeling the primary artifacts.

combined_confirmatory_inference.pooling_prerequisite: All nine seeds must use identical frozen model, workload, policy, budget, pairing, and audit contracts; otherwise cohorts are reported separately.
combined_confirmatory_inference.p_value_role: confirmatory evidence alongside effect size, seed-cluster interval, memory matching, all-seed direction, and worst-slice constraints; never a sole success criterion

execution_order: finish and audit the immutable five-seed primary core cohort
train and calibrate four additional checkpoints per scale
run exact equivalence before extension quality evaluation
complete the full extension core Cartesian grid
complete calibration-only physical memory matching and causal equivalence
complete the full extension causal Cartesian grid
audit cohorts separately, then emit a combined nine-seed summary only if the pooling prerequisite passes
failure_rules: Do not replace a failed primary seed with an extension seed.
Do not stop the extension after favorable interim outcomes.
Count operational failures conservatively in the registered aggregate.
Keep the five-seed and four-seed raw matrices independently reproducible even when combined inference is valid.
